TCD.note: The document states nothing on e-procurement.

The document states nothing on digital finance consumer rules.
The document states nothing on cross-border payments.
The exchange platform named is between litigants, lawyers and courts, not between government systems.
The online complaints and requests platform is for filing legal cases with the justice system, not feedback on public services, and is only at tender.
The document states nothing on government payments to people.

facts.fact: UNDP Chad's report says UNDP launched a tender on 5 June 2024 for a firm to build a platform between litigants, lawyers and the judicial system, for online complaints and requests, case notifications and document filing, with bids then before the RACP.
